lines.text: Many learners say: I study at the morning.
Better: I study in the morning.
In! I drink tea in the morning.

native.tip: نقول in the morning: “I study in the morning.” وليس “I study at the morning.”.
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “I study at the morning.” 😅 نقول in the morning، فالجملة الصحيحة “I study in the morning.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “in”. نقول in the morning. اختبار مجاني هنا: {link}

en.hook: Do you say “I study at the morning”?
en.tip: We say in the morning: “I study in the morning.” not “I study at the morning.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “I study at the morning.” 😅 We say in the morning, so the right sentence is “I study in the morning.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
